data.title: BNPL Account Opening Risk Signal Cluster
data.description: Detects BNPL account applications exhibiting multiple risk signals indicative of synthetic identity fraud. Specifically targets accounts opened with email domains less than 30 days old, minimal digital footprint (score below 0.2), and patterns consistent with emulator-based mass account creation. BNPL providers using soft-check-only approval processes are particularly vulnerable to synthetic identities that pass initial verification but exhibit these digital footprint anomalies. This rule supports detection at Phase 2 of TP-0040 by identifying high-risk onboarding patterns before the synthetic identity progresses to credit grooming and multi-provider stacking.

enrichment_required.source: Identity verification enrichment (digital footprint scoring service)
WHOIS enrichment (email domain registration date lookup)

falsepositives: Young consumers opening their first financial accounts with limited digital history
New email service adopters who recently migrated to a new email provider
Immigrants or expats establishing new digital identities in a new country
